Jordan / Marissa — thanks for the ping. Quick summary from Billing Ops: we can issue invoices directly to Vertex Europe Ltd (local legal-entity billing) provided we have the following on file:

1) Signed Purchase Order referencing the MSA (we have Vertex_PO_78934.pdf in the thread).
2) Official VAT registration document (they attached Vertex_EU_VAT_Certificate.pdf) — sufficient for VAT line on invoice.
3) Confirmation of bank wiring or EFT recipient — Vertex Europe Ltd bank details OR confirmation they want to be billed via Vertex Systems (US) as an invoice proxy (in which case we bill the US entity and include the EU entity as a reference).

Notes:
- If Redwood bills the EU entity directly, invoices will include VAT and will be payable to the Vertex Europe Ltd payee. Nets will be Net60 as requested; our system will honor the PO number field for automated matching.
- If they want invoice proxy (Parent invoiced), we need a signed authorisation from Vertex Europe Ltd stating the US parent can be invoiced on its behalf and confirm who will remit payment. That usually slows processing.

Action items for Vertex procurement to return: bank beneficiary details for the EU entity OR signed proxy authorization.

I'm attaching a draft proforma invoice (Redwood_Invoice_PROFORMA_20270515.pdf). Marissa — please confirm pricing/term alignment so I can finalize the invoice number and post it.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
